- Banding inconsistencies when reviewers used different anchors for scope and impact.
- Confusion about ownership of complex cross-functional work (credit split).
- Perceived variance in rubric application for stretch/performance improvement items.

Adding my proposed reconciliation heuristic (short):

1) Owner-first: assign credit to the team that owned the roadmap/ticket origin (60%).
2) Contribution floor: significant contributions from another team (>25% effort or feature ownership) bump split to 50/50.
3) Evidence requirement: any deviation from the default split must be accompanied by: tickets, PRs, and manager confirmation (one-line).
4) Tie-break: for unresolved cases, escalate to the calibration panel for a final, documented decision.

I updated the spreadsheet (tab: Proposed_Heuristic) and inserted inline comments on the 20 borderline cases. I also removed personally identifiable feedback from the shared sheet where it wasn’t necessary.

On sensitive cases (potential demotion/discipline risk), we should surface those to HR in a separate thread — Laura, can you confirm preferred channel/time?

-karthik
